# Matchday hospitality trends, autumn edition

This season's executive boxes are all about local sourcing: three in four premium lounges now list the farm behind every dish. Also inside: why craft soft drinks are outselling wine in family enclosures, and a chef's guide to half-time service in under twelve minutes.
